scope: Explicit BASE db.zip/hdrs.zip RPS table and upgrade matchup adjustments for the current57 definition mappings. Existing role aliases remain explicit; this does not reconstruct all native attack abilities, armor modifiers, elevation, formations, veterancy or civilization effects.
sourceProfile: BASE db.zip and hdrs.zip; matched to the existing BASE unit-stat profile

007dbef0.formula: rawDamage * table[defenderRPS][attackerRPS] * adjustmentLookup(attackerType,defenderType), then additional target defense modifier

007da960.conditions: base class multiplier>0 and abs(upgrade adjustment)>=epsilon
007da960.implementationEquivalence: All BASE table/adjustment integers in this profile are nonnegative, so combined multiplier>0 gives the same decision.

007dfdf0.rps: Repeats the class and upgrade lookup for each defender, not just the original target
007dfdf0.splash: Original primary target retains full damage; secondary centers use(1-distance/radius)^2 inside radius, zero at/outside radius.

implementation.lookup: 57×15 role/epoch map →269 explicit native source profiles
implementation.upgradeIdentity: Own stable integer IDs represent exact original upgrade names; pairs do not depend on matching the native database numeric order. Existing class-stat audit CSV source line selects the exact upgrade, including duplicate UNIT/EPOCH rows.
implementation.missingUpgradeScope: Farm, CitizenM, OilRig and UraniumMine source rows have no matched upgrade. None of the BASE221 adjustment entries names Citizen/Farm/OilRig/UraniumMine upgrades; these profiles retain the native class multiplier and default adjustment1.
implementation.unknownProfile: Explicit None fallback permits existing weapon/armor behavior for unmapped invalid/unavailable profiles.
implementation.basePreservation: Integrated with ee2-reference guards; actual base53 before/after equivalence passed16economy/epoch scenarios plus2mixed-army combat scenarios.

engineHook.damage: Native matchup multiplier replaces own weapon/armor matrix when both profiles are known; existing player defense modifier remains. Unknown profiles preserve fallback.
engineHook.targets: Acquire, manual attack orders, cached-target resolution and firing reject zero native matchups.
engineHook.projectiles: Attacker profile captured at launch; defender current epoch evaluated separately per target at impact, including splash.
engineHook.areaDamage: EE2 uses center distance and squared secondary falloff, retaining full primary-target damage. Base keeps existing radius-adjusted linear falloff.
engineHook.saveCompatibility: Ent/Player/save layouts unchanged; existing saves deliberately discard projectiles. Attacker profile is a transient feature-gated Proj field.

sourceImportTests.observed: Actual unittest invocation completed OK; every raw CSV cell and named adjustment compared, source hashes and269 profile/source-line bindings checked.

standaloneRustTests.observed: Actual compiled Rust tests passed: asymmetric class matchups, unknown fallback, upgrade factor, squared splash golden vectors, all269² bounded profile matchups.

limits: The analyzed installed UP engine loader uses dbcomba5.csv and dbcombat_unittypeadjus5.csv. This generated profile deliberately uses BASE tables consistently with existing BASE stats; installed UP data equivalence is not claimed.
This does not implement every native attack ability, accuracy, armor, elevation, formation, veterancy, civilization bonus, invulnerability or projectile lifetime mechanism.
Projectile attacker-profile capture and float32 WebAssembly operation ordering are reconstruction choices; a full x87/runtime pointer-lifetime equivalence audit is outside this slice.
Current role/visual aliases are retained from the existing unit audit. Native numerical source bindings do not make those names/roster slots a full original recreation.
originalInstallation: Read only. No CUA/native game launch or GUI used.
